recent_items.summary: Reproducible finite-sample analysis of append-only copying in conformal calibration. The project contains five public regression benchmarks, three fixed model families, 30 random splits, six copying mechanisms, three coverage targets, independent score simulations, and exhaustive rank checks. recent_items.summary: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. recent_items.title: The Value of Memory in Language Agents

recent_items.summary: Memory helps LLM-based multi-agent systems reuse experience, but stored advice can be flawed or applied in the wrong situation. Team-level success or failure alone cannot reliably show whether a memory needs correction or should not have been used. recent_items.title: Remembering Is Not Enough: Refining Memories and Learning When to Use Them in Multi-Agent Systems

recent_items.title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
